### Changeset, re-read

The bullet "gets the same button pinned at the content's top-right corner" now reads: "gets the same button over the empty top end corner of its content (top-right; top-left in a right-to-left language) … A page that keeps its own controls in that corner draws the group in its own top bar instead, so the button never covers them: the report builder (a new report, and a report's Edit) ends its header with Discard, Save, help, Ask AI, and the inbox ends its header row with its own buttons, help, Ask AI." The frontmatter adds `'@object-ui/plugin-report': patch`, and the closing paragraph names the new optional `headerEnd` prop.
